title: Your first Spanish word
explanation: Someone is meeting you. The Spanish word is Hola. Read it as ola. It means hello.

title: Read Hola
explanation: Read Hola as ola. In this word, the written h is quiet.

title: Read hola
explanation: You see hola. You say OH-lah. The first letter is quiet.

title: Stable Spanish vowels
explanation: Read the vowel sounds clearly in the words you learn: hola, adiós, gracias, and por favor.

title: Greetings by time of day
explanation: Use buenos días in the morning, buenas tardes in the afternoon, and buenas noches in the evening or at night. Hola works at any time.
